title: 1.6 Parents and Grandparents
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Name the father, mother, parents, grandparents, and grandchildren, and say who each one is with es or son.
grammar_function: El/La/Los + family noun; Él/Ella es el/la + noun; Ellos son los + plural noun.
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.5: people, articles, es/son, ellos/ellas, and plurals.
speaking_outcome: Say who is a parent or a grandparent.

cards.pedagogy_note: padre takes el.
Él (he, with an accent) + es + el (the, no accent) + padre.
madre takes la.
Ella + es + la madre.
padres = parents (a father and a mother together).
Ellos for a man and a woman; son for who they are.
abuelo takes el.
abuela takes la.
abuelos = grandparents, like padres = parents.
nietos = grandchildren; y joins the two groups.
